actions.message: Great job on your high contribution! Keep it up.

answer.explanation: Average contribution is above 45%, so baseline 80% contribution applies (86.4). No free‑riders to punish. Private praise is given to Resident4 who contributed >=60% of their wallet.

message.reasoning:
We need decide action round 3. Wallet is 108. Baseline 80% = 86.4. Check average contribution round2: total contributed 432 pool => sum contributions = total_pool / multiplier? Actually pool = sum*1.5 => sum = 432/1.5 = 288. Average per agent = 288/6 = 48. So average 48 which is 48% of endowment (100). That's above 30% and below 45%? 48% >45, so revert to baseline 80% contribution. So contribute 86.4 (but must be nonnegative absolute, can fractional). Wallet 108 enough. Also check any free riders: need two consecutive rounds <10% endowment (=10). Look at contributions: Resident3 contributed 60 both rounds, Resident1 20 then 60, Resident2 60 then 40, Resident4 0 then 128, Resident6 80 then 64. No one under 10. So no punish. Broadcast norm every 5 rounds: round3 not needed. Could private praise those >=60% of wallet. My wallet 108, 60% = 64.8. My contribution 86.4 > 64.8, also others: Resident1 contributed 60 (>=64.8? No). Resident2 40 no. Resident3 60 no. Resident4 128 >64.8 yes. Resident6 64 <64.8? 64 <64.8, no. So praise Resident4. Private message.

Thus actions list: contribute 86.4 and private_message to Resident4.
